identification: Four modern children's books: Beatrix Potter Classic Tales omnibus (Warne), Carroll Through the Looking-Glass (modern jacketed reprint), The Annotated Alice (Gardner, Tenniel; Potter-style jacket, could be 1960 first, later Potter printing or Bramhall House reprint), Milne Winnie the Pooh Complete Collection (modern omnibus). Only the Annotated Alice has any chance of real value, and only as a 1960 first printing.

chrome_hint: eBay AU and eBay.com sold: 'Annotated Alice Gardner 1960 Clarkson Potter first edition' and 'Annotated Alice 1960 dust jacket'; compare 1960 first (price in AUD, jacket state) against later Potter printings and Bramhall House (usually under AUD 40). Also AbeBooks / Biblio sold-comparable listings for 'Annotated Alice 1960 first edition Clarkson N. Potter' (first edition has no later-printing statement; Potter 1960 first is typically AUD 100 to 300 if jacketed, to be verified). Rare Book Hub and Invaluable for 1960 firsts. The other three titles are common modern reprints; no search needed.
viewing_check: Open the Annotated Alice to the copyright page (back of the title page): look for 'First edition' or printing line, publisher Clarkson N. Potter (not Bramhall House), and any later printing statement. Check the jacket price on the front flap and for chips, plus any library stamps or inscriptions. Other three books need only a glance for edition and condition.
rate_note: All figures are AUD; no conversion used.
